name: مستندات الذات | استقبال حالة مسودة تجريبية - دون ملفات

parameters.jsCode: const incoming = $input.first().json.body || {}; const allowed = ['eventType','documentRef','revision','status','createdAt']; const result = {}; for (const key of allowed) { if (typeof incoming[key] === 'string' && incoming[key].length <= 120) result[key] = incoming[key]; } const valid = result.eventType === 'draft_ready' && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,120}$/.test(result.documentRef || '') && /^\d{1,6}$/.test(result.revision || '') && result.status === 'pending_review'; if (!valid) throw new Error('Invalid or incomplete metadata; no document payload accepted'); return [{json:{ok:true,accepted:true,documentRef:result.documentRef,revision:result.revision,notice:'Metadata only. No PDF, names, signatures, or student records are accepted.'}}];
